title: PairRequest

code.description: The pairing code, as typed or as the link's fragment carries it; case, spaces and hyphens are ignored.

kind.description: What kind of client a client session belongs to: the desktop window, the terminal UI, a browser tab, or a program (a script or bot driving the wire).

label.description: A name for the client session, for people.

protocolVersion.description: A wire protocol version: one integer, bumped only on a breaking change.

description: A client's exchange of a pairing code for a client session.
